_comment: Tier-2 CORRECTION: pitfall (kratos.auxiliary_overview #5) states that BOTH KratosContactStructuralMechanicsApplication (modern) AND the legacy KratosContactMechanicsApplication / KratosSolidMechanicsApplication are NOT published on PyPI, and that 'there is no pip-only path to Contact physics in Kratos 10.x'. THE FIRST HALF IS FALSE at 10.4.3: pip installs KratosContactStructuralMechanicsApplication==10.4.3 and import KratosMultiphysics.ContactStructuralMechanicsApplication succeeds. Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The LEGACY half of the claim stands — ContactMechanicsApplication and SolidMechanicsApplication both raise ModuleNotFoundError and have no wheel at any version. This fixture pins the corrected state: modern contact IS pip-reachable, legacy contact is not. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
